batch102 independent read-only review
Snapshot: Candidate c199d4ca7073a14c6d8a286ba5e0c6410f30f7ae; frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f; accepted RU cef2c36a32956c819614f6923a743f2fd75d7164. Opening and closing gates completed with exit 0 and identical bound-scope SHA256 be30602f24b98e06d357ad4450192f113aa1f2626232fffbbbb083985f019594. Both reported 2216 candidate objects, preservation of 2208 baseline objects, and four raw-identical new stroke files.
Scope: All 59 prescribed reading windows returned completely, with their trailers and exit 0: four complete guidance documents and three rubrics; four primary EN/RU pairs; 19 context EN/current-RU pairs; two EN-only comparison bodies; 22 KANJIDIC2 records, three radical records, one header, 73 JMdict entries, four KanjiPedia captures; all 354 typed candidate rows; 12 proposals, four lesson adjudications, four clarifications, four outside-limit observations and six exact baseline-to-candidate navigation diffs. No failed/unread windows.
C1 CLEAN: Within the four new lessons, readings, okurigana metadata, stroke counts, classical keys/numbers, compound readings and meanings agree with the bound evidence. Community N3 levels and source tags are preserved, not inferred from historical KANJIDIC JLPT numbers. Mnemonics are expressly non-etymological; no unsupported historical, frequency or necessity claim was established in the lesson prose. Selective tables do not purport to teach all retained kun readings.
C2 UNVERIFIED for unrestricted active-negative quiz safety; CLEAN for the inspected dependency/navigation changes: all new lesson links resolve within the bound candidate set; missing optional word pages remain plain Japanese with readings. The 12 directed comparisons are individually supported at introductory/source-core level, not as unrestricted quiz guards. Known pool overlaps below remain material fallback risks. Neither author metadata retention nor mechanical passes closes those risks.
C3 NEEDS FIX (minor): Russian explanations are otherwise understandable without English; Japanese examples retain readings and nav wrappers preserve visible prose. The register warning in 婦 uses an unexplained calque; see F001.
N001婚→始 S-intro; ordinary U: 始 title «начало; начинать» is not a marriage meaning of 婚. Shared 女 supports the shape comparison; marriage beginning is an event association, not lexical equivalence. Checked independently of N005.
N002婚→借 S-intro; ordinary U: 借 «брать взаймы; арендовать» differs from marriage. 日 occurs inside different right-hand structures 昏/昔. KANJIDIC confirms core borrowing senses; no standalone 借 JMdict entry was bound.
N003婚→曜 S-intro; ordinary U: 曜 «день недели» is not a 婚 sense; shared visible 日 has a different location. KANJIDIC supports the weekly-day core. No standalone 曜 JMdict entry was bound.
N004婦→帰 S-intro; ordinary U: 帰 «возвращаться домой» is not a 婦 meaning. Shared right-hand structure is a strong visual comparison. 帰 とつ.ぐ concerns marrying, but that is a secondary sense of the foil, not proof that its actual return-home label answers 婦. No reverse approval.
N005婦→始 S-intro; ordinary U: 始 «начало; начинать» does not express woman/wife. Shared 女 supplies visual similarity only. This direct direction was judged independently, not inferred through 婚.
N006婦→姉 S-intro; ordinary U: 姉 «старшая сестра» specifies a sibling relation absent from 婦; the fact that a sister is a woman does not make that specific label a 婦 meaning. Shared 女 supports comparison. Broader female/honorific senses matter especially in the reverse direction, which is not approved here.
N007存→字 S-intro; ordinary U: 字 «письменный знак» does not answer existence/knowledge. 字 secondary address/name senses also do not establish that label for 存. Shared 子 is real; only 字 has the 宀 roof described.
N008存→右 S-intro; ordinary U: 右 «правый; справа» is not a 存 sense. 右 hand, above-mentioned, right-wing and better-of-two senses do not supply this label for 存. Similar upper outlines, different lower parts.
N009存→左 S-intro; ordinary U: 左 «левый; слева» is not an existence/knowledge meaning. Its following-text and drinking senses do not establish the displayed label for 存. Direct comparison, not inferred from N008.
N010対→文 S-intro; ordinary U: 文 «предложение; письменный текст» does not mean facing/opposition/pairing. Dialogue/text association is not lexical equivalence. The 文-like left shape is qualified as modern resemblance, not historical composition.
N011対→持 S-intro; ordinary U: 持 «держать; иметь» is not a 対 meaning. The separate 持 じ draw/tie sense is not in that displayed label and does not license a holding gloss for 対. Shared 寸 inside 寺 supports shape comparison only.
N012対→時 S-intro; ordinary U: 時 «время; час» does not answer 対; time/occasion/opportunity and suffix senses do not establish it. Shared 寸 inside 寺 supports comparison; independently judged, not inferred through 持.
L001婚 SUPPORTED-intro: Marriage domain, 結婚/離婚 contrast and small っ are supported; the photograph mnemonic makes no historical claim.
L002婦 SUPPORTED-intro: Wife in 夫婦, household role supplied by 主婦 and adult-woman sense of 婦人 are supported. よめ remains metadata/reference, not a recommended everyday spelling. Register wording requires F001.
L003存 SUPPORTED-intro: Existence/preservation and knowledge/belief senses are supported. Replacing the English save/rescue contrast with Russian computer-data saving is legitimate.
L004対 SUPPORTED-intro: Facing, opposition and pairing are supported; dialogue need not imply hostility. 一対 いっつい and the 寸-in-寺 comparison are correct.
A001 SUPPORTED-bounded: Cited marriage/divorce/ceremony entries support the taught senses; archaic くながい is not taught.
A002 PARTLY SUPPORTED: Core forms/senses are supported, including rarely written 婦 よめ in 1191680. However, 2857591 is tagged «dated term», not «literary» in the returned entry; that additional characterization is U and is not taught in the lesson.
A003 SUPPORTED-bounded: 存在/保存, humble 存じる and established respectful ご存じ agree with the entries; these are not interchangeable register forms.
A004 SUPPORTED-bounded: 対 たい/つい, 反対, 対話, 一対 and 対する agree with the captured senses. No universal hostile interpretation is justified.
NAV01 words/ご存じ.md: NAV-ONLY; one whole-label [存じ](../kanji/存.md) wrapper, precisely matching the amendment shape identified in the bound record (49fadb5). No split label or change to 存じる/ご存じ/ご存知. Correct existing target; visible prose unchanged.
NAV02 words/反対.md: NAV-ONLY; standalone 対 wrapper targets ../kanji/対.md; existing 反 link and all visible text/metadata preserved.
NAV03 words/婦人.md: NAV-ONLY; standalone 婦 wrapper targets ../kanji/婦.md; existing 人 link, sensitive/dated explanation and quiz arrays preserved.
NAV04 words/対する.md: NAV-ONLY; standalone 対 wrapper targets ../kanji/対.md; relationship explanation and quiz arrays unchanged.
NAV05 words/看護婦.md: NAV-ONLY; standalone 婦 wrapper targets ../kanji/婦.md; obsolete female-specific usage and modern 看護師 contrast unchanged.
NAV06 words/結婚.md: NAV-ONLY; standalone 婚 wrapper targets ../kanji/婚.md; reading, と pattern and married-state explanation unchanged. All six exact patches show only their authorized wrappers; existing line-ending preservation is within the gate/bound evidence, not a separate byte inspection by me.
Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001 marriage-domain association with 帰/妻/夫 is supported, not proof those displayed spouse/return-home labels are synonymous with 婚. O002 confirmed 婦–女/妻 label overlap; lesson disclosure is not a fallback guard. O003 confirmed 存–在/有/知 displayed-meaning overlap; no transitive guard inference. O004 対–反/向 facing/opposition affinity is supported; unrestricted fallback protection U. No outside-limit edits or new guard approvals; old 天/夫 prose and 時 metadata were not repaired or certified.
Findings: F001 — minor, C3, kanji/婦.md, «Частые слова», 婦人 bullet: «потенциально чувствительное» is an unexplained English-sensitive calque rather than a clear Russian usage warning. A beginner cannot reliably infer whether this concerns offensiveness or emotional sensitivity. Replace it with «требующее осторожности из-за возможной оскорбительности», keeping the attribution to the cited dictionary and avoiding a blanket claim that every occurrence is offensive. Evidence: JMdict 1496670 misc sensitive/dated term and the completely read current words/婦人.md, which already explains that distinction. Confidence: high for the clarity defect; no claim about measured learner outcomes.
Optional: In A002 replace the unsupported capture characterization «literary» with the actual «dated term» or explicitly qualify it as separately unverified. In the 婦 explanation «один из членов супружеской пары» is more natural than «одна из двух сторон»; this is polish, not a separate defect.
Limits: No live web pages were consulted; KanjiPedia was read only through the four bound text captures, not pixels or live HTML. No git, tests, builds, validators, installs, file mutations or delegation were performed. Source records establish readings/senses, not frequency or learning effectiveness. Unrestricted quiz behavior, fallback sampling, reverse directions and full secondary-sense coverage across the other 354-row pool bodies were not established; runtime code/options were not supplied. The amendment is evidenced by the bound NAV record and gate, not by a separately opened full signed amendment. No device/media/native-speaker certification or whole-corpus approval.
